$comment: Linica foundation tokens for issue #1. Values are measured from the PNG exports in this repository, or taken from the historical README scale rule, or marked TODO when a solid unambiguous sample was not available. Do not treat Flutter theme values as canonical.

sources: booking-app/*.png and inventory-app/*.png on main (head f0b153a at time of measurement)
Historical README foundation section at commit f1e3b925e9e8f2e0e6c2a221270217541e66f14f (the current README dropped that section on 2026-11-18)
notSources: prototype/index.html viewer chrome (rose #BD7779, canvas #F7F5F2, ink #252A32) styles the HTML prototype shell, not the product mockups

primary.name: teal
primary.source: Exact header fill on booking-app/signin.png and inventory-app/signin.png (100% of the top bar sample). Also used for the SIGN IN footer action, selected inventory navigation, and the un-allocated segment of inventory-app/overview.png.
primary.note: The historical README suggested a soft rose/coral primary. That colour does not appear in the product PNGs and is not used here. Teal is the measured brand colour.

accent.name: sky blue
accent.todo: Confirm the exact accent hex in the Adobe XD specs.
accent.observed: Clinic and location labels such as “KPA - HQ @ Parkdale” render as a bright sky blue on booking-app/review-pay.png, booking-app/select-nurse.png, booking-app/treatments.png and booking-app/treatment-time-selected-1.png. The 188px exports only contain antialiased samples (#228CFF, #278EFF and mid-blues such as #55A6FF, #5DAAFF, #85C0FF). No un-antialiased solid fill was found.

surface.name: white
surface.source: Page fill on the interior booking and inventory screens, including booking-app/treatments.png, booking-app/review-pay.png, inventory-app/overview.png and inventory-app/reports.png.

surfaceSubtle.name: off-white
surfaceSubtle.source: Treatment list card field on booking-app/treatments.png (quantised samples #FAFAFA / #FAFAFB, about 14% of the artboard). Related cool greys also appear: #F9F9FA on slot chips in booking-app/treatment-time-selected-1.png and #EFEFF2 on inventory-app/reports.png.
surfaceSubtle.note: Optional supporting token. The required surface role is #FFFFFF.

text.name: black
text.source: Solid headline and body fill on booking-app/treatments.png, booking-app/review-pay.png, booking-app/treatment-time-selected-1.png, inventory-app/overview.png and inventory-app/reports.png.
text.note: The historical README described text as charcoal dark grey. The dominant solid fill in the mockups is #000000. #12131A and #1A1A1A also appear in small counts on some screens (for example inventory-app/home.png and booking-app/signin.png) but were not used as the text token because they are not the solid body fill on most screens.

error.name: red
error.source: Solid samples on inventory-app/reports.png and inventory-app/report-outside-temps.png (warning icon and temperature range). The Cancel label on booking-app/current-services-name-4.png samples #E33F3F / #E44444, the same family; this token uses the solid report value.

errorSurface.source: Warning banner fill on inventory-app/report-outside-temps.png. The Cancel control fill on booking-app/current-services-name-4.png is a lighter pink, #FEF3F3.

success.name: green
success.source: Solid samples on the “5% increase in usage this week” chip and the in-range segment of the temperature bar on inventory-app/reports.png and inventory-app/report-outside-temps.png. Also used for “In Operating Range” on inventory-app/details.png.

warning.name: mustard / gold
warning.todo: Confirm the exact warning ink hex in the Adobe XD specs.
warning.observed: The “LOW UN-ALLOCATED STOCK” chip on inventory-app/overview-low-un-allocated-stock.png uses warningSurface #EFECD9 with a mustard/gold label and icon. The 188px export only contains antialiased ink samples (#C7BD7B, #D2CA96 and nearby golds). No un-antialiased solid ink fill was found. A similar cream chip is used for “Next expiry in 1 week” on inventory-app/inventory.png and inventory-app/details.png.

warningSurface.source: Exact low-stock chip fill on inventory-app/overview-low-un-allocated-stock.png (878 solid pixels in the chip crop).
warningSurface.note: Optional supporting token. The required warning role is the ink colour, which remains TODO.

spacing.source: Historical README at f1e3b92: “Use an 8px spacing base with 4px increments for tight adjustments.” This scale is a documented rule, not a set of paddings measured from the PNGs.
spacing.todo: Confirm individual component paddings and gaps against the 375-wide Adobe XD artboards. Half-scale PNG measurements of padding were not reliable enough to publish as tokens.

card.todo: What is the card corner radius on the 375-wide Adobe XD artboards? A single unambiguous value could not be recovered from the 188px PNG exports (card edges are hairline borders with antialiased corners).

button.todo: What is the button corner radius on the 375-wide Adobe XD artboards?
button.observed: The unselected slot chip on booking-app/treatment-time-selected-1.png has a top-border row inset by 2 PNG pixels from the side border, which scales to about 4px at 375 wide. That observation is for the slot chip only and is not published as the button token, because the primary black CTAs and the outlined “Sign in with Google” button did not yield the same clean count.

card.source: Booking and inventory cards in the PNG exports are separated from the page by a light hairline border, not a visible drop shadow (see booking-app/review-pay.png, booking-app/treatments.png, inventory-app/reports.png).

headline.todo: What are the headline size, weight and line height on the 375-wide Adobe XD artboards? Cap-height could not be recovered reliably from the antialiased 188px exports.

body.todo: What are the body size, weight and line height on the 375-wide Adobe XD artboards?

label.todo: What are the label size, weight and line height on the 375-wide Adobe XD artboards?

type.note: Issue #1 asks for roles, not font files, unless a font is already in the Adobe file. Licensed font files are not in this repository. fe-fltr-inventory docs/design-parity.md reports that the inventory XD specs use Sofia Pro and Proxima Nova; that report was not re-verified in XD for this work and is not a token.
